|strategy=By [mailto:swartz2@tcnj.edu Fred Swartz : swartz2@tcnj.edu]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/tacticalsupport.html</ref>

I think [[Tactical Support]] is one of the coolest cards around. Let's consider the possibilites: Suppose you have [[Veers]] in your hand and you're playing on [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]]. Use [[Tactical Support]] to bring three Stormtroopers into your hand. Deploy [[Veers]] and the Stormtroopers, and for three Force you've just given yourself a power of 9 and a bunch of forfeit. The trick with [[Tactical Support]] is to do it before you activate any Force so that way you don't have to worry about your troopers being in your Force pile instead. The fact that you have to lose a force to use it isn't great, but I think it's a fair trade, especially if you make sure you lose from your hand so you don't end up losing [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]].
